newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to privatise Banque Hervet.
newsitem.headline: France to privatise Banque Hervet.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Friday France would privatise Banque Hervet through a public offering this year.
"The government has decided to launch the privatisation. The situation permits us to forsee a sale on the market, that is to say by public offering," Arthuis said at a news conference.
He said the government would try to privatise the bank "by the summer" or in any case by the end of the year.
The French government abandoned its first attempt to privatise Banque Hervet in 1994 after it posted a 1.2 billion franc loss in 1993 because of real estate losses.
After being recapitalised by the state the bank posted a 70 million franc profit in 1996.
